page.layout: One text column, left of centre, inside a ruled frame. Running head "NOTÆ." centred at top with page number 243 at top right. Signature "Ii 3" at bottom left and catchword "creat" at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Acer fuit & pertinax sectæ hujus Author in opinio-nibus suis (inter quas est nondum creata esse Para-disum & infernum) propugnandis, adeo ut كان جوز القتل والغيلة على المخالفين لمذهبه واخذ اموالهم غصبا وسرقة لاعتقادهم كفرهم واستباحة دمائهم Licere diceret illos, qui ipsi contradicerent è me-dio tollere, & insidias seu fraudem illis facere, & bona ipsorum vi apertâ diripere vel furto auferre, eo quòd eos pro infidelibus haberet, quorum sanguinem fundere licitum esset. Secunda sententia est AlJabariorum rigidiorum, quales AlJahamiani (Jahmi cujusdam, qui circa finem imperii Ommiadarum floruit secta) qui asserunt (referente AlShareslanio) ان الانسان ليس يقدر على شيء ولا يوصف بالاستطاعة وانما هو مجبور في افعاله لا قدرة له ولا ارادة ولا اختيار وانما يخلق الله تعالى الافعال فيه على حسب ما يخلق في سائر الجمادات وتنسب اليه الافعال مجازا كما تنسب الى الجمادات كما يقال انبرت الشجرة وجری الماء وحرك{3} الحجر والثواب والعقاب جبر كما ان الافعال جبر قال واذا ثبت الجبر والتكليف ايضا كان جبرا Non posse hominem rem aliquem facere, neque attribui ipsi debere quòd potentiâ præditūs fit, sed illum coactum producere opera sua, cùm non sit ipsi potentia nec voluntas, nec electio, creare autem Deum in ipso actiones uti

page.notes: Black blotch over the start of "insidias" on the 3rd line: a stain or dust mark, not a printed word, so the words beneath are read as best possible. The Arabic is transcribed from a small scan and is tentative; words I am unsure of should be checked against a higher-resolution image. The superscript "3" in "وحرك الحجر" is a printed mark with no matching note on this page. "prædituṡ" in the Latin is read as "prædītus" with uncertainty; the printed form is not clear at this resolution. Whether "Non posse hominem..." starts a new paragraph is not clear from the scan, so it is kept in the same paragraph. The catchword "creat" is the first word of the next page.
